comparison.objective: Block two lenses for edging, each block 8 mm temporal of optical center; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests precise registration and block placement on delicate lenses; candidate tests inserted hex-key use, counterholding, collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both blocks at the specified optical offsets; candidate requires two safe repeated stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Precision optical registration is a different tested ability from adjustable impact control. No specs, placement tolerance, adhesion, or lens-damage criteria are provided.
